about.story_p1: MT Travel started in 2005 with one small boat and a simple idea: show visitors the Bodrum peninsula the way locals actually experience it - unhurried, personal, and a little off the postcard route.
about.story_p2: Two decades later, we run more than twenty tours and transfer services across the region, from Greek island ferry crossings to ancient ruins, jeep safaris and private charters. What hasn't changed is the team: licensed local guides who grew up on this coastline and still get genuinely excited to share it.
about.timeline_2005: MT Travel is founded in Bodrum with a single boat and a handful of loyal guests.
about.timeline_2011: We expand into island day trips, adding regular ferry-based excursions to Kos and beyond.
about.timeline_2016: Our team grows to cover jeep safaris, scuba diving and long-distance day trips to Pamukkale and Ephesus.
about.timeline_2022: We introduce a streamlined, guest-friendly reservation process with instant confirmation.
about.timeline_today: Thousands of guests a year trust us for tours across the whole Bodrum peninsula and beyond.
